messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T bitcoin miner

Depends mostly on your power bill and budget. Two picks:

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s, 485 W turbo (230 W in ECO), ~50 dB, ships November 30. The quiet, low-power one.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at ~650 W. Cheapest per terahash we sell, about $20/TH. It's a pre-order batch, I'll confirm its exact ship date for you.

Both are solo-cap····plug into a normal outlet. What state or country will it run in? I'll run real numbers at your electricity rate.
I m frm india I want to start mining with harlos

Good news, the Harlos run on 100 to 240 V, so Indian 230 V mains is fine, and we match the plug to your address.

Two Harlos:

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s Bitcoin only, 485 W turbo or 230 W in ECO. Ships November 30.

Harlo H15 Dual, $799, 15 TH/s Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s Dogecoin/Litecoin at ~500 W.

One thing to budget for: it ships from our US warehouse, so Indian customs duty and GST are charged on delivery and aren't collected at checkout.

What's your power cost per unit, roughly?
Magic miner I think it will suitable for me

Good pick on value, it's our cheapest per terahash at about $20/TH.

Just be clear on the power: 40 TH/s pulls around 650 W, versus 230 W for a B30 in ECO. In India that's the main running cost, so it suits you if your tariff is low and you have the headroom.

Current one is Batch 9, $799, a pre-order. I'll confirm the exact ship date on that batch rather than guess.

Here it is: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/magic-miner-40t

Want me to build the cart?
839 $ is more expensive in my currency almost 80,000

Understood, and prices are fixed in USD, I can't change them. But there are smaller ways in.

Hammer Miner Thor P2, $379, 10 TH/s at only ~166 W, quiet at ~40 dB. In stock.

Hammer Miner BC04, $249, 6 TH/s at ~100 W. In stock.

Both cost more per terahash than the 40T, but the upfront and the running cost are far lower, which matters at Indian tariffs. Remember customs and GST land on top either way.

What budget in rupees are you working with? I'll point you at the best fit.
